name: larptech-agent-prompts
description: Version-controlled prompts and evaluation cases for the Larptech bounded-agency agents

scripts.eval:offline: rm -f naive-results.json; promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfooconfig.offline.yaml --no-cache --no-table --filter-providers naive -o naive-results.json || true; node evals/check_results.mjs naive-results.json --expect-failures 9 --total 12
scripts.eval:offline:oracle: rm -f oracle-results.json; promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfooconfig.offline.yaml --no-cache --no-table --filter-providers oracle -o oracle-results.json || true; node evals/check_results.mjs oracle-results.json --require-all-pass
scripts.eval:offline:security: rm -f naive-security-results.json; promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfooconfig.offline.security.yaml --no-cache --no-table --filter-providers naive_analyst -o naive-security-results.json || true; node evals/check_results.mjs naive-security-results.json --expect-failures 7 --total 12
scripts.eval:offline:security:oracle: rm -f oracle-security-results.json; promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfooconfig.offline.security.yaml --no-cache --no-table --filter-providers oracle_security -o oracle-security-results.json || true; node evals/check_results.mjs oracle-security-results.json --require-all-pass
scripts.gate: npm run validate && npm run validate:security && npm run eval:offline && npm run eval:offline:oracle && npm run eval:offline:security && npm run eval:offline:security:oracle
